name: Robotics Camp
org: San Diego State University (SMILE Lab and Talent Search)
what_you_do: Spend a week at SDSU. You learn to code in Scratch and Python, build and program MBot Mega robots, and fly and program drones. You also learn about AI, cyber safety and clean energy, tour STEM labs and hear guest speakers.
who_can_apply: Middle and high school students in grades 8 to 12. A STEM teacher must fill out a short recommendation form for you.
pay_detail: Free to attend. Snacks and lunch are included.
deadline_text: The page says the application period runs February to May and that the 2025 application period has ended. No 2026 or 2027 dates are posted.
how_to_apply: When the application opens, fill out the student form. Ask a STEM teacher to send the short teacher form. Questions: SDSU Talent Search, 619-594-3474 or talentsearch@sdsu.edu.
notes: Confirm first: the camp page still talks about 2025. The SDSU Talent Search page says the U.S. Department of Education ended Talent Search funding and the program is closing out, so ask whether the camp will run again.
